clinicalPearls: Left recurrent nerve longer: left palsy commoner
Image skull base to aortopulmonary window in idiopathic palsy
Ortner syndrome is cardiac left cord palsy
Bilateral palsy: voice okay, airway threatened
reference.pathophysiology: Posterior cricoarytenoid sole abductor failure closes glottis in bilateral recurrent lesions, while high vagal injury adds pharyngeal and palatal paralysis compounding aspiration beyond cord gap.
additionalDifferentials: Arytenoid dislocation versus nerve palsy (trauma, palpation mobility)
Unilateral versus bilateral palsy priorities (voice versus airway)
Superior versus recurrent laryngeal injury after thyroidectomy
additionalInvestigations: CT skull base to mediastinum for unexplained palsy
